mapper.sql: emp54_errand_id AS errandId , emp54_person_id AS personId , f_emp_kor_nm(emp54_person_id) AS personName , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) AS orgName , emp54_errand_cd AS errandCode , f_cdnm('ErrandCode', emp54_errand_cd, emp54_company_id, emp54_date) AS errandName , emp54_date AS date , sys12_weekday AS weekday , emp54_depart_time AS departTime , emp54_return_time AS returnTime , emp54_reason AS reason , emp54_venue AS venue , emp54_host AS host , emp54_note AS note , emp54_appr_id AS apprId , apr01_status_cd AS aprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS aprStatusName , (COALESCE(emp54_public_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS publicYn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp54_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '전체공개' ELSE ( SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN emp56_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(emp56_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(emp56_org_id, f_today()) END FROM emp56_share WHERE emp56_parent_id = emp54_errand_id ORDER BY emp56_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM emp56_share WHERE emp56_parent_id = emp54_errand_id ) END AS shareInfo

FROM emp54_errand INNER JOIN sys12_calendar ON ( sys12_company_id = emp54_company_id AND sys12_day::date = emp54_date ) LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp54_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp54_person_id = emp03_person_id AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp54_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_today() ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp54_errand (emp54_errand_id, emp54_company_id, emp54_person_id, emp54_errand_cd, emp54_date, emp54_depart_time, emp54_return_time, emp54_reason, emp54_host, emp54_venue, emp54_note, emp54_appr_id, emp54_public_yn) VALUES (#{errandId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{errandCode}, #{date}, #{departTime}, #{returnTime}, #{reason}, #{host}, #{venue}, #{note}, NULL, CAST(#{publicYn} AS VARCHAR))

INSERT INTO emp54_errand SELECT f_create_seq() , emp54_company_id , emp54_person_id , emp54_errand_cd , #{date} , emp54_depart_time , emp54_return_time , emp54_reason , emp54_host , emp54_venue , emp54_note , emp54_appr_id , emp54_public_yn FROM emp54_errand WHERE emp54_errand_id = #{errandId} AND emp54_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE emp54_errand SET emp54_appr_id = #{apprId} WHERE emp54_errand_id = #{errandId} AND emp54_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp54_person_id = #{personId}
UPDATE emp54_errand SET emp54_public_yn = CAST(#{publicYn} AS VARCHAR) WHERE emp54_errand_id = #{errandId} AND emp54_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp54_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM emp54_errand WHERE emp54_errand_id = #{errandId} AND emp54_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp54_person_id = #{personId}
